notes: Scan 96 is a manuscript text sheet in the author's hand with three slanting left-margin passages, two marginal separator rules and a double stepped angle before Bien. The only number is the lighter lower-left archive folio 95, assigned to another unnamed hand; there is no visible author page number.

The body continues a conjectural sufficiency claim for the conditions under discussion and then separates the issue of uniqueness over algebraic extensions of Q from the positive-transcendence case. It suggests uniqueness when K is finite over the moduli field. The final paragraph returns to lifting an endomorphism of a connected groupoid and breaks off after sommet.

The written body has avec extension with no K before extension and has X a = degré de transcendance without the extra comparison que K supplied by H. Both omissions are retained. The final morphism is explicitly endomorphisme.

The middle note questions whether the anabelian hypothesis is required and states that the variation X/K de dim 1 seems inessential; its parenthetical example clause is partially unreadable. It then expressly says the claim is false for G_m. These are the author's statements, not verified conclusions.

The lower note says the result should be provable with what he knows via Белый; the tiny abbreviation before via remains uncertain. For uniqueness it calls the anabelian condition absolutely essential. No proof or counterexample has been supplied by this reader.

The complete second reading and root inspection withdraw the alleged fixe x_0 de point générique insertion: no independent sequence or attachment exists apart from intersecting established body and marginal text. Its old uncertain inventory entry is withdrawn. The unreadable extent after tentative N’est cannot be counted and is now illegible{?}.

The lower middle-margin rule also underlines the En fait sentence. It is represented once as a TikZ rule rather than duplicated with a separate uline. The upper rule and double body angle are likewise represented as simple polylines.

Every visible body and marginal token, including C/H agreements, cancellation extent, inserted qualifier, indexes, alphabets, punctuation and underlines, was compared. H's editorial synopsis and bracket descriptions are excluded from manuscript text.

No OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used. No mathematical proof check was performed; check_events is intentionally empty. Model GPT-6 Astra Pro; reader_b, first reading; effort not exposed.

The final groupoid noun is literally groupoide: one compact point stands over i, with no separate second point. Both witnesses normalize it to a diaeresis. This local reading does not propagate to other occurrences.

The terminal point after the last marginal G_m is unsupported. The m is beside the rising separator edge and other body strokes; no independent point can be identified. The caveat itself remains exactly as written.

All 40 inherited comparison loci, 17 mark decisions and 16 original inventory entries were reviewed; after withdrawal of the phantom insertion there are 15 supported elements. Five inherited doubtful loci remain, including the middle unreadable run with unknown word count. No new mathematical check event.
